title: Phaseo · Overview
description: Check received traffic and failures, then investigate the affected service. Scheduler freshness is not an external uptime check.

options.content: Check **Service request health** for failures and slow responses, then **Grouped failures** for the affected route, error or job. Click a failure card to investigate its service. Counts cover received events; scheduler freshness does not establish external uptime.

panels.title: Scheduler telemetry · last 5m
panels.description: At least one recent heartbeat confirms scheduler telemetry is arriving. This does not test the website or generation endpoints from outside Cloudflare.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.heartbeat" | __error__="" [5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Gateway requests
panels.description: Received terminal gateway request events in the selected time range. Includes success, error and cancellation; not a billing count.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Gateway failures
panels.description: Actionable logical request failures, including failures after streaming HTTP 200. Client cancellations are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", actionable="actionable" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | actionable="true" | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Web API requests
panels.description: Web API response-header events in the selected time range. This is separate from gateway generation traffic.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Web API 5xx
panels.description: Server-error responses only. Expected client rejections such as 401 and 404 are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Job failures
panels.description: Job invocations that threw or explicitly reported known item failures. A completed handler can still contain internally handled failures.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | outcome="error" | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Traffic · per interval
panels.description: Each point counts events in the preceding query interval, with a five-minute minimum. The window grows with the query step on long ranges so events between points remain counted. Web API and gateway are separate traffic populations; do not add them as unique requests.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failures · per interval
panels.description: Received failure events per category in the preceding query interval, with a five-minute minimum. The window grows with the query step on long ranges so short spikes remain counted. These are not distinct incidents; one incident can produce events in multiple categories.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", actionable="actionable" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | actionable="true" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.server_error" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | outcome="error" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="ops.failure" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Gateway p95 duration
panels.description: 95% of received terminal gateway timings are at or below this value. Includes streamed response completion. Interpret with request volume; a percentile from very few requests is unstable. Missing timing stays empty.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (service_name)

panels.title: Web API p95 headers
panels.description: 95% of received web API timings reach response headers within this duration. Does not measure full streamed response completion. Empty means no matching timings, not zero latency.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", duration_ms="duration_ms" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (service_name)

panels.title: Gateway outcomes
panels.description: Counts in the selected time range. Cancellation is separate from success and error; error is not always operationally actionable.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Web API responses by status
panels.description: Counts by HTTP status in the selected time range. A 4xx response is a client rejection and is not automatically an outage.

targets.expr: sum by (status_code) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Web API 5xx by route
panels.description: Up to 10 route templates with received server-error responses in the selected time range. Empty means no matching events, not confirmed availability.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", route="route", status_code="status_code" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="web.request" | status_code >= 500 | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Provider attempt failures
panels.description: Up to 10 providers with failed attempts in the selected time range. Retries and fallbacks can recover, so these are not necessarily failed customer requests. Attempt detail is capped per request.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (provider) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", provider="provider", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="provider.attempt" | outcome="error" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent actionable events
panels.description: Start with the newest event. Expand it for service, route, job, outcome and request/trace IDs. No matching events does not establish external uptime.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"phaseo-gateway|phaseo-web-api|phaseo-web|phaseo-jobs"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", actionable="actionable" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | actionable="true"

options.content:
**API failures:** open [Gateway and providers](/d/phaseo-gateway?var-environment=$environment&from=$__from&to=$__to) and look for shared providers, outcomes or request IDs. **Website problems:** open [Web experience](/d/phaseo-web?var-environment=$environment&from=$__from&to=$__to); browser errors and Web Vitals are in [Frontend Observability](/a/grafana-kowalski-app). **Job or settlement failures:** open [Jobs and settlement](/d/phaseo-jobs?var-environment=$environment&from=$__from&to=$__to).

Expand a log, then search its `trace_id` in **Explore → Tempo**. Only 5% of backend traces are retained; a missing trace is expected for most requests. Compare the incident time with [recent deployments](https://github.com/phaseoteam/Phaseo/actions/workflows/ci.yml). After a fix or rollback, test the affected page or endpoint directly and confirm errors settle. [Alert rules](/alerting/list) show notification-rule state; this dashboard itself does not send notifications.

Web API duration measures response headers; gateway duration measures terminal completion.

panels.title: Grouped failures
panels.description: Up to 20 most frequent failure groups in the selected range. Inspect category, code, digest and route, then expand matching logs for source frames. Event counts are not distinct incidents or affected users. Error messages and customer content are not collected.

targets.expr: label_replace((topk(20, sum by (service_name, route, event_name, error_kind, error_code, error_name, error_digest, status_code, job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway|phaseo-web-api|phaseo-web|phaseo-jobs"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", route="route", error_kind="error_kind", error_code="error_code", error_name="error_name", error_digest="error_digest", status_code="status_code", job="job", actionable="actionable" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | actionable="true" | __error__="" [$__range])))), "measure", "Events", "", "")
